mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blacklist (scope, platform, bot_id, group_id, user_id, reason) VALUES (#{scope}, #{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{userId}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT id, scope, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, user_id AS userId, reason, created_at AS createdAt FROM blacklist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (scope = 'global' OR (scope = 'group' AND platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId})) LIMIT 1
SELECT id, scope, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, user_id AS userId, reason, created_at AS createdAt FROM blacklist ORDER BY id DESC
